protocol_template.scope: exact sum of completed disjoint activity families; certified full-hull lower bound
protocol_template.candidate_queue_policy: bounded pending families; endpoint-group balancing and turnover; preserve proofs/frontiers/active jobs
protocol_template.search: adaptive input/internal activity domains; fixed-domain collapsed exact Z^m replica/PT jobs; auxiliary ensemble; disjoint exact union

corridor_search.restriction: each X_1..X_(R-1) has <= k active nibbles; X_R is post-P and unrestricted
corridor_search.exact: integer transfer over every path in the declared corridor, no weight cutoff

adaptive.score: fixed-domain exact Z^m; no cross-domain Metropolis comparison
adaptive.finite_budget_scope: opened and attempted domains reported; full scope not guaranteed

corridor_search.stored_endpoints: top candidates from evaluated rows, NOT equilibrium samples
corridor_search.resource_failure: unfinished row UNKNOWN; expensive discovered pairs use separate persistent bidirectional transfer
corridor_search.input_proposal: activity-stratified independence MH with exact Hastings ratio; input ASN > 4*k is provably impossible and omitted

endpoint_exact.discovery: only witnesses/certificates already discovered or explicitly reused by this campaign
endpoint_exact.exact_scope: all paths with ASN(X_1)..ASN(X_(R-1)) <= cap at the selected endpoints
endpoint_exact.method: bidirectional integer transfer; smaller integer width; parallel transactional batches
endpoint_exact.checkpoint: layer/source cursor plus accumulated integer frontier, checksummed atomic scratch files
endpoint_exact.probability_gate: F/count gate applies to per-pattern conditioning only; DP messages are not completed trail-family probabilities

joint_patterns_search.cap_affects: joint search only; exact family model unchanged
joint_patterns_search.internal_blocks: single-state value Gibbs plus two-state collective MH with full proposal normalization

protocol_template.evaluation: cost-planned adaptive conditioning; exact support propagation, lazy DDT factors, cached independent components, bounded integer contractions, disjoint checkpoint frontier
protocol_template.exact_method: sum-product integer variable elimination with disjoint adaptive conditioning
